_comment: Single source of truth for the shop: templates, /theme.css, the cart JS and the server-side price check all read this file. Prices are in cents. `claims.numbers` only renders when site.json claims_locked is true.
serving: One pouch is one serving: sweet cream base, a flavor swirl and a crunch mix-in, packed separately so the crunch stays crunchy.

flavors.name: Vanilla Crunch
flavors.short: Vanilla bean swirl + crunchy cereal bites
flavors.vibe: Warm cream, vanilla yellow, toasted beige.
flavors.description: Sweet cream base, a rich vanilla-bean custard swirl and a generous pile of toasted cereal crunch. No chocolate, no fruit, nowhere to hide - this is the flavor that proves how good the base is.

swirl.name: Vanilla bean cream swirl
swirl.desc: A custard-style vanilla swirl, flecked with real vanilla bean.

crunch.name: Toasted cereal crunch
crunch.desc: Vanilla cereal clusters and toasted oat bites. Big pieces, real snap.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), oats. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Strawberry Shortcake
flavors.vibe: Soft pink, strawberry red, cream, golden shortcake.
flavors.description: White pudding, a glossy strawberry swirl and a heap of pale-gold shortcake crumbs with freeze-dried strawberry bits. The ice-cream-truck bar, grown up.

swirl.name: Strawberry swirl
swirl.desc: Bright, glossy strawberry - more jam than syrup, so it ribbons instead of disappearing.

crunch.name: Shortcake crunch
crunch.desc: Vanilla shortcake crumbs, strawberry crumbs and tiny freeze-dried strawberry pieces.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), wheat, oats. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Blueberry Cobbler
flavors.description: A baked-spice sweet cream base, a deep blueberry compote swirl folded through it, and chunky cinnamon brown-sugar cobbler crumble on top. Built for the close-up.
flavors.base: Sweet cream + a hint of baked spice

crunch.name: Cobbler crunch
crunch.desc: Irregular toasted crumble with cinnamon and brown sugar, plus freeze-dried blueberries.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), wheat, oats. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Birthday Cake
flavors.short: Vanilla frosting swirl + cake crunch + sprinkles
flavors.description: Yellow-cake sweet cream, a vanilla frosting swirl and cake-cookie crunch with sprinkles. Confetti energy without the kids'-cereal nonsense.

crunch.name: Cake crunch + sprinkles
crunch.desc: Cake-cookie pieces, cereal crunch and rainbow sprinkles.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), wheat, oats, soy. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Cookies & Cream
flavors.tagline: Kept pale, so the cookie hits harder.
flavors.description: Sweet cream base kept deliberately white, a cookies-and-cream swirl, and dark chocolate cookie rubble that reads almost black against it.
flavors.base: Sweet cream + a whisper of cookie

swirl.name: Cookies & cream swirl
swirl.desc: Vanilla cream with crushed cookie through it.

crunch.name: Chocolate cookie crunch
crunch.desc: Dark chocolate cookie rubble and cocoa crisps.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), wheat, oats, soy. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Chocolate Brownie Fudge
flavors.vibe: Milk chocolate, dark fudge, warm brown, cream.
flavors.description: Cocoa oat pudding, a thick dark fudge swirl and brownie-cookie chunks. Glossy, thick and excessive - and still the same base underneath.

crunch.name: Brownie crunch
crunch.desc: Brownie-cookie chunks and chocolate crisp pieces.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), wheat, oats, soy. May contain: peanuts, tree nuts - final per formula.

flavors.name: Choco Peanut Butter
flavors.tagline: Thick peanut ribbon. Exaggerated on purpose.
flavors.vibe: Peanut caramel, cream, dark chocolate, roasted tan.
flavors.description: Peanut-butter sweet cream, a chocolate-peanut ribbon that refuses to blend in, and roasted peanut pieces with chocolate oat crunch.

swirl.name: Chocolate-peanut butter swirl
swirl.desc: A dominant peanut ribbon with dark chocolate running through it.

crunch.name: Peanut crunch
crunch.desc: Roasted peanut pieces and chocolate oat clusters.

claims.allergens: Contains: milk (whey), peanuts, oats. May contain: tree nuts, wheat - final per formula.

boxes.name: The Starter Box
boxes.blurb: One of everything. The right first order.

boxes.name: Build-a-Box 14
boxes.blurb: Fourteen pouches, any mix. Two weeks of breakfast, or one very good week.

boxes.name: Build-a-Box 28
boxes.blurb: A month, your way. The best price per bowl.

boxes.name: 7-pack
boxes.blurb: Seven of one flavor. For when you know.
